note: anchor = ground contact (feet). Scale so traveler ~1.2% of planet radius.

beast_run_to_greet.note: loop run 0-7 while distance>1.5 traveler heights, then play greet once facing traveler. Art faces E; mirror for W.

beast_contact_shadow.note: place under anchor, multiply blend, align to surface normal

ground.note: Tileable 256. Edges: grass at bottom (edge), bottom-right (outer), all but top-left (inner); rotate 90° for other sides. Simpler on a sphere: drive a 0-1 coverage field (spread from beast gathering points) and use the edge mask noise as a threshold.

wind.shader_hint: angle = amp*weight*sin(t*2pi*freq + dot(worldPos,windDir)/waveLen) ; bend about pivot in tangent plane

window_glow.note: billboard ~0.6 beast height, offset up-left of beast; pulse opacity 0.35-0.7 at 0.25 Hz; brighten when env state updates. It's the beast peeking into its person's reality.
